APPROVE
The refactored `Uses` comes to about 14 (loop, the three guarded `if`s and their `&&`s), and every extracted helper (`SkipEnd`, `BracketDelta`, `IsForeignReference`) keeps the original short-circuit order and `seen.Add` side effect, so behaviour is unchanged; the source wasn't available here, so I couldn't confirm that the dictionary's value type is really named `Foreign`, which the build depends on.
